tests.action: Use a fresh browser profile. Open #/auth/signin. Leave Phone Number empty and select Continue. Do not sign in yet.
tests.expected: Phone Number is required is shown. The PIN dialog stays closed and no protected page opens.

tests.action: Keep this browser session. Enter 12345 in Phone Number and select Continue. Do not sign in yet.
tests.expected: Invalid phone number is shown. The PIN dialog stays closed and no protected page opens.

tests.action: Keep this browser session. Replace the phone number with TEACHER_PHONE and select Continue. In the Enter PIN dialog, leave all digits empty, then enter only three digits. Inspect Verify in both cases. Close the dialog with Escape. Do not use Forgot PIN or request an SMS.
tests.expected: The PIN dialog opens for the registered teacher. Verify remains disabled with zero or three digits. Escape closes the dialog without signing in.

tests.action: Keep this browser session. Enter TEACHER_PHONE and select Continue. Enter 0000 and select Verify exactly once. TEST_PIN is between 1000 and 9999, so 0000 is incorrect. Do not retry the wrong PIN or use Forgot PIN. Close the dialog after observing the result.
tests.expected: Invalid PIN is shown and the user remains signed out. No protected page opens.

tests.action: Sign in once using TEACHER_PHONE/TEST_PIN. If a baseline survey appears, choose Remind later when offered; otherwise complete it once with valid test responses. Wait for the permitted landing page. Keep this browser session for subsequent tests in the group. Use hash routes (#/...) for direct navigation; resolve record IDs through the UI instead of using placeholder URLs. Report skipped if an explicitly required record or fixture is absent. Do not generate presentations.
tests.expected: The teacher reaches Home or the first permitted page; teacher navigation is shown and admin navigation is hidden.

tests.action: Reuse the teacher session after the successful sign-in. Open #/home, reload the browser page, and wait for the page to load. Do not sign in again.
tests.expected: The teacher remains signed in after reload. Home and teacher navigation are shown without a PIN prompt or profile-completion redirect.

tests.action: Reuse the teacher session. Open #/profile and wait for the profile to load. Check the name and phone number fields are read-only. Leave the profile and saved class assignment visible for the screenshot.
tests.expected: Identity fields are visible and remain read-only.

tests.action: Reuse the teacher session. Open #/content-generation/lesson-plan. Leave required selections incomplete and try to generate a lesson plan. Do not fill all required fields or start generation. Leave the form and its validation state visible for the screenshot.
tests.expected: Generation is disabled or validation identifies the missing fields.

tests.action: Reuse the teacher session. Open #/schedule. Switch between My Schedules and Others' Schedules and wait for each view to load. Empty schedules are valid. Leave the calendar visible for the screenshot. Do not create or edit events.
tests.expected: Both schedule tabs load without an error. The selected tab shows its calendar and events or an empty state.

tests.action: Reuse the teacher session. Open the profile menu, choose Log out, and confirm the logout dialog. Then open #/home directly and reload. Do not sign in again.
tests.expected: Logout returns to sign-in. Opening and reloading the protected Home route keeps the user at sign-in and shows no protected data.
